packages.title: Choose how to start

noFit.title: None of these fit your case?

advisory.title: Two ways to start, without building a full system.
advisory.lead: For businesses that first want to know what's worth it, or want their team to learn how to do it themselves.

diagnostic.name: Automation Diagnostic
diagnostic.subtitle: Before you invest, know what's worth automating and what isn't.

features.one: 1 to 2 working sessions with your team to understand how your business runs today
features.two: Mapping of your current processes, spotting where automation creates real impact
features.three: A written deliverable with prioritized opportunities and a clear recommendation

diagnostic.note: If you hire one of the three packages within the following 30 days, the diagnostic's cost is deducted from the project.

training.name: AI Productivity Training
training.subtitle: Get your team using AI to automate their own work, not just talking about AI.

features.one: A 4-session hands-on program, not a theory lecture
features.two: Each participant applies AI to a real task from their day-to-day work
features.three: Tools and prompts built for your business's specific context
features.four: Follow-up between sessions to answer questions and adjust the approach
features.five: A deliverable with the workflows your team can keep using on their own

differentiation.title: How this differs from a generic course
differentiation.body: This isn't a generic course about AI: every session starts from your team's real tasks, so what they learn gets applied that same week to their own work, not to a case study unrelated to your business.

one.title: Diagnosis
one.body: We talk through your business and find where automation creates the most impact.

two.title: Proposal
two.body: We show you exactly what gets automated, how it works and what to expect.

three.title: Implementation
three.body: We build the system and leave it running inside your business.

four.title: Support
four.body: We follow up every month so everything keeps working well.

one.question: Do I need to be technical to use this?
one.answer: No. We handle everything. You just see the results.

two.question: How long does it take to implement?
two.answer: It depends on the scope, but most businesses see results within a few weeks.

three.question: Does this replace my team?
three.answer: No. It frees your team from repetitive tasks so they can focus on what matters most.

four.question: What if I need help after delivery?
four.answer: Ongoing support is included. We don't leave you on your own.

five.question: Does it work for my kind of business?
five.answer: We work with businesses that depend on replying fast and booking well. If that's your case, most likely yes.

six.question: Does the diagnostic replace the free 15-minute strategy call?
six.answer: No. The free call is for us to get to know each other and see if we're a fit. The diagnostic is a deeper analysis, with a written deliverable, on what to automate and what not to in your specific business.

seven.question: Do I need to hire an AI agent to take the training?
seven.answer: No. It works as a standalone service. Many businesses use it as a first step before deciding whether to automate anything.

eight.question: Can I hire both services together?
eight.answer: Yes. In fact, the diagnostic is usually the natural first step before the training or before any of the three packages.

about.title: About us
about.body: We are Numi AI: a team of five software engineers specialized in bringing artificial intelligence automation to small and medium-sized businesses in Colombia. We work with businesses that depend on replying fast and booking well — aesthetic clinics, real estate agencies, veterinary clinics, dental practices and gyms — designing every system around their real operation, never from a generic template.
about.mission: To help businesses operate better by removing repetitive tasks with artificial intelligence applied to their reality, not to a generic template.
about.vision: To be the technology partner of reference for small and medium-sized businesses in Colombia, known for real results rather than promises.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: How Numi AI collects, uses and protects the personal data it receives through its contact form.
privacy.intro: Numi AI collects personal data solely through the contact form on this site. This policy explains what data we receive, what we use it for and how you can request its deletion, in compliance with Colombia's Law 1581 of 2012.
privacy.dataIntro: Only the data you type into the form:

data.six: The description of what you need to automate

privacy.useIntro: For two purposes, and no others:

use.one: To contact you in order to schedule and hold the strategy call you requested.
use.two: To assess your case and prepare a proposal suited to your operation.

privacy.sharing: Nobody. We do not sell, transfer or share your data with third parties, and we do not use it for advertising or to build profiles.
privacy.retention: We keep your data for as long as there is an active commercial conversation with you. If you ask us to delete it, we do.
privacy.rightsTitle: Your rights and how to exercise them
privacy.rights: You may ask us at any time to tell you what data of yours we hold, to correct it, or to delete it entirely. We respond within the timeframes set by law.
privacy.rightsContact: For data deletion requests, write to us at
